title: jumppower
features:
this script change your jumppower to jump higer or jump lower

how to use

read the script :)
script:
local plrs = game.Players
local plr = plrs.LocalPlayer

jumppower = 100; -- defule is 50 :)
-- english super
-- change number on the jumppower to change power
-- very pro

if plr then
	local char = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	if char then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.JumpPower = jumppower
		end
	end
end
